tool.name: pmotools extract_pmo
tool.description: Extract subsets of a PMO by metadata, specimen names, library samples, targets, or read count
tool.command: pmotools-python $extract_mode.subcommand --file '$input_pmo' --output '$output_pmo' @OVERWRITE@ #if $extract_mode.subcommand == "extract_pmo_with_selected_meta": #if str($extract_mode.metaFieldsValues_source.metaFieldsValues_source_selector) == "text": --metaFieldsValues '$extract_mode.metaFieldsValues_source.metaFieldsValues' #elif str($extract_mode.metaFieldsValues_source.metaFieldsValues_source_selector) == "file": --metaFieldsValues '$extract_mode.metaFieldsValues_source.metaFieldsValues_file' #end if #if $extract_mode.verbose: --verbose #end if #elif $extract_mode.subcommand == "extract_pmo_with_select_specimen_names": #if str($extract_mode.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_source_selector) == "text": --specimen_names '$extract_mode.specimen_names_source.specimen_names' #elif str($extract_mode.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_source_selector) == "file": --specimen_names '$extract_mode.specimen_names_source.specimen_names_file' #end if #if $extract_mode.verbose: --verbose #end if #elif $extract_mode.subcommand == "extract_pmo_with_select_library_sample_names": #if str($extract_mode.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_source_selector) == "text": --library_sample_names '$extract_mode.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names' #elif str($extract_mode.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_source_selector) == "file": --library_sample_names '$extract_mode.library_sample_names_source.library_sample_names_file' #end if #if $extract_mode.verbose: --verbose #end if #elif $extract_mode.subcommand == "extract_pmo_with_select_targets": #if str($extract_mode.targets_source.targets_source_selector) == "text": --targets '$extract_mode.targets_source.targets' #elif str($extract_mode.targets_source.targets_source_selector) == "file": --targets '$extract_mode.targets_source.targets_file' #end if #if $extract_mode.verbose: --verbose #end if #elif $extract_mode.subcommand == "extract_pmo_with_read_filter": --read_count_minimum $extract_mode.read_count_minimum #end if

param.name: metaFieldsValues_source_selector
param.label: Metadata field values input method
param.option: Upload a metadata field values file

param.name: metaFieldsValues_file
param.label: Metadata field values file
param.help: A table with columns: field, values (and optionally group)

param.name: specimen_names_file
param.label: Specimen names file
param.help: Plain text file with one specimen name per line

param.name: library_sample_names_source_selector
param.label: Library sample names input method
param.option: Upload a library sample names file

param.name: library_sample_names_file
param.label: Library sample names file
param.help: Plain text file with one library sample name per line

param.name: targets_file
param.label: Target names file
param.help: Plain text file with one target name per line

param.name: read_count_minimum
param.label: Minimum read count
param.help: The minimum read count (inclusive) for detected haplotypes to be kept

tool.help:
@HELP_PREAMBLE@
**Extract from PMO**
Extracts a subset of a PMO file based on one of the following criteria:
- **By selected metadata**: Extract samples and haplotypes matching selected metadata field values. The metadata field values can be provided as a command-line string (format: ``field1=value1,value2:field2=value1``) or as a tabular file with columns ``field``, ``values`` (and optionally ``group``). - **By specimen names**: Extract specific specimens by name. Names can be comma-separated or provided as a text file (one per line). - **By library sample names**: Extract specific library samples by name. Names can be comma-separated or provided as a text file (one per line). - **By target names**: Extract specific targets by name. Names can be comma-separated or provided as a text file (one per line). - **By read count filter**: Keep only haplotypes with read counts at or above a specified minimum.
**Input**
- A PMO JSON file (optionally gzipped)
**Output**
- A subset PMO JSON file
